review: Recovered independent M7 freeze readiness v2
scope: Prelaunch design, statistical method, retained review tests, seed isolation, history preservation, and runner/checkpoint/audit schema compatibility. This is not a replacement for the parent-owned full default pytest or final post-data independent audit.

design.schedule: 24 arm orders each repeated10, each arm60 at each within-quartet position; every48-game checkpoint12 complete quartets

statistics.non_iid_justification: Primary paper Theorem1.12 checked directly: two-sided equal-tail CP at confidence>=.5 covers independent nonidentical Bernoulli average probabilities. Project two discordance component intervals and apply union bound; apply second union bound across three estimands. Within-quartet arm dependence is unrestricted. Independent quartets remain an explicit hypothetical PRNG-stream model, not a consequence of collision-free hashes.
statistics.sensitivity: Six fixed strata; correctly computed Student-t/Satterthwaite variance and df, explicitly approximate and nonconfirmatory; degenerate estimated variance yields no CI.
statistics.selection: Formal sample, three-member family, primary intervals, and fixed-size stopping are pinned before first game. M6 cost selects balanced resource allocation without using pilot effect estimates. Outcome-selected M6 draw regressions are engineering checks only and add no observations. No efficacy checkpoint analysis, seed replacement, trimming, imputation, or outcome-based extension.

schema_compatibility: Inspection and synthetic960 roundtrip confirm freeze provenance, source/plan locks, proof hash maps, manifest games_per_cell/checkpoint_games and completed validation snapshot schema match independent audit. Checkpoint validator invokes frozen-input gate and only accepts48-game boundaries. Sync whitelist rejects inherited/narrative paths and requires verified zero-game anchor after production starts.
remaining_release_gates: Parent full default pytest v3 exit0 and stable before/after input inventory.
Final preservation check after all tests; create-only aggregate freeze lock including fresh reviews.
Verify initial remote technical source/plan checkpoint and fetch before first production game.
limitations: Review does not prove independent PRNG streams or internal MCTS/rollout execution.
Primary interaction interval may be inconclusive; crossing zero is not absence or equivalence.
Approximate sensitivity cannot replace/intersect/override primary finite-sample intervals.
A safety pause is incomplete, and coverage should not be claimed conditional on an uneventful completed run.
No automatic7x7, training, or next experiment.
